thread:
kevin_ng: heads-up — our APAC edge hub subnet in ap-southeast1 is basically out of allocatable IPs when the A100 worker pool scales. Observed failures provisioning new nodes for dedicated-a100-prod this morning :grimacing:

maria_ops: ugh. which subnet? can you paste the CIDR and a quick `gcloud` output?

kevin_ng: subnet is `10.40.128.0/24` (hub-usg-edge-subnet). autoscaler wants to bring +12 A100 VMs (n1-standard preemptible for now) and we saw ENI attach failures. `gcloud compute instances list --filter="name~'a100' AND zone:ap-southeast1*" --format="table(name,networkInterfaces)"` returned ~48 NICs already in use.

ana_platform: likely we're hitting per-subnet internal IP exhaustion + per-instance ENI limit per project. Also check secondary ranges if using GKE alias IPs.

kevin_ng: we aren't using alias IPs for this cluster; plain VMs. Also NAT SNAT port exhaustion on the existing single NAT gateway — logs show many ephemeral ports in TIME_WAIT. NAT has 1 EIP right now.

vipin_cloud: summary of asks to open with cloud support: 1) Increase A100 quota in ap-southeast1 from 8 -> 32 (we need headroom for pilot). 2) Increase regional external IP quota from 8 -> 32 (for NAT+HA EIPs). 3) Increase VM/ENI attach limits (project-level) or provide guidance on ENI scaling. 4) Approve adding a secondary /26 (or at least /28) to hub VPC for edge subnets. 5) Request expedited handling — customer onboarding.

maria_ops: can we avoid external IP increases by deploying two NAT gateways with internal proxying? that would still need EIPs (one per NAT), but reduces port collision. Alternative: use Cloud NAT with multiple IPs per NAT.

kevin_ng: yep, we've tested Cloud NAT with multiple IPs in a single NAT mapping — but current quota prevented us from adding more external IPs to the NAT config. Also need advice on cross-account peering: these edge VMs belong to a different billing account (service account project). We want shared hub NAT in central account. Peering + Private Service Connect used elsewhere. Any restrictions on using a shared NAT from another project?

ana_platform: tech notes for support case — include example commands and logs. Paste small snippets: 
```
# showing attached NICs
gcloud compute instances list --filter="networkInterfaces.network:projects/my-org/global/networks/hub-vpc" --format="csv(name,zone,networkInterfaces[0].networkIP)"
# ip usage by subnet
gcloud compute networks subnets describe hub-subnet --region=ap-southeast1 --format=json | jq '.ipCidrRange'
```

maria_ops: what's the current free IP count in the /24?

kevin_ng: ~9 free IPs left. Autoscaler needs 12 more. If we reserve a /28 (16 addresses, ~11 usable) that might just squeak by but we want a /26 ideally.

vipin_cloud: cost tradeoffs: reserving /26 vs adding NAT EIPs. /26 will consume address space but avoids extra public EIPs and reduces SNAT churn. /26 in that region won't cost much besides management. But A100 quota bump is main cost — each A100 instance ~costly per-hour; recommend staging scale-up during off-peak.

kevin_ng: proposed support case payload (draft):
- Project: my-corp-edge-prod (123456789012)
- Region: ap-southeast1
- Quotas to increase: GPUs (type a100) from 8 -> 32, External IP addresses from 8 -> 32, VM instance quota from 250 -> 500 (regional), Instance NICs/ENI limit raise from 20 -> 80 (project-level)
- Network: add secondary range `/26` to VPC `hub-vpc` and allow subnet `edge-subnet-*` expansion; enable cross-project shared NAT usage.
- Business justification: urgent customer onboarding and inference capacity for production LLM workloads. Request expedited turnaround.

maria_ops: add logs showing attach failures and NAT port counters as attachments. Also include terraform plan snippet showing desired subnetwork change: 
```
resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "edge_secondary" {
  name          = "hub-edge-secondary"
  ip_cidr_range = "10.40.192.0/26"
  region        = "ap-southeast1"
  network       = google_compute_network.hub.self_link
}
```

ana_platform: also request guidance on temporary mitigations: 1) enable Cloud NAT with 4 EIPs across 2 NAT gateways; 2) shift some worker pools to a different AZ or region (cost/latency tradeoff); 3) use smaller GPU shapes (like T4) for baseline until quotas fill.

kevin_ng: ack. I'm going to open the support case with the payload above and ping support with priority P2. I'll add the attach failure logs and NAT metrics. Case draft in #support-case-drafts for review.

vipin_cloud: after case opens, ask for a short teleconference with the cloud quota team. I've had luck getting faster turns when we include customer onboarding docs and an architecture diagram. I'll add one. :thumbsup:

maria_ops: thanks — once the /26 is approved we'll update terraform and run a rolling scale. cc @sre_bot to schedule a maintenance window if NAT changes require ip switchover.

sre_bot: scheduled maintenance check created — tentative window Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Will confirm after support case update.

kevin_ng: sweet. I'll post the support case ID when created. Appreciate the quick triage :eyes:
